blocks.body:
## Technical summary

The score has not merely remained statistically similar: every completed current bundle selects the same official-FM fallback, and the corresponding submission artifacts are byte-identical. The recent sprint built useful candidate machinery, but it did not move a new ranking function through reliable selection. The best reproduced train-fold portfolio is extremely close to the internal materiality boundary, while the broad experiment history shows that nDCG@5—not GAUC—is now the harder component.

The most evidence-efficient route is therefore: faithfully reproduce and confirm the existing three-member rank portfolio; add genuinely new label-free query-period exposure state; target top-five ordering with duration-conditioned pairs and a corrected LambdaLoss or hard-negative control; then test watch-progress as training-only multi-task supervision. More residual capacity on the same frozen feature matrix is a lower-priority bet.

The selected primary value above is the strongest retained fallback seed, not a multi-seed mean and not a challenger improvement. The valid five-seed FM mean is 0.6015721679. Candidate comparisons must use matched seeds and the same scorer; comparing a seed-0 candidate against the retained seed-4 fallback can manufacture a difference larger than the only prior matched-seed challenger effect.

## Why the seven-hour sprint did not move the selected score

The sprint produced many executable surfaces, but selection stayed at the same fallback. Twenty-three completed current bundles across the inspected run families contain the same selected candidate and identical final prediction hashes. The newest improvement sequence completed fifteen campaigns without one new outer evaluation. Six historical outer slots were charged to six fingerprints that resolve to the same candidate, source, and three-seed prediction vector.

The faithful 0.15 pointwise + 0.30 video-type + 0.55 official-FM within-user rank portfolio produced +0.002005756 on Fold B and +0.001987755 on Fold A. It is the closest reproduced treatment, but it still misses the strict both-fold rule by 0.000012245 on Fold A and has no multi-seed or protected confirmation. Attempt 22 did not test that recipe: it moved the largest weight to raw video type, substituted pairwise FM for the control inside the candidate, and then fused against the control a second time.

Across all inspected records, average GAUC gains are about 1.47 times average nDCG@5 gains. The Fold B baseline's large deterioration relative to Fold A is also almost entirely nDCG@5. A new experiment should therefore explain which rank-one-to-five swaps it expects to fix; another global residual model without that mechanism is unlikely to break the plateau.

## Where new score-moving information still exists

The selected FM uses only five fields. The research candidates expanded to 83 columns, but prediction-time histories are frozen at the training prefix and do not update through legal query inputs. That leaves exposure, fatigue, first-seen, and time-since-last state unused. The training log also contains strong scenario heterogeneity and dense auxiliary outcomes that can supervise representation learning without becoming inference features.

## Prioritized score-improvement program

Priority 1 is the cheapest faithful confirmation of an already-supported composition. Priorities 2–6 introduce distinct information or objective alignment one mechanism at a time. They are ordered by expected information gain and implementation risk, not by architectural novelty.

## What the bounded diagnostics falsified now

Click and profile-entry are associated with long view, but training standalone auxiliary rankers and blending their scores into the strongest base portfolio made Fold B worse at every tested non-zero weight. This rejects the cheap direct-score shortcut; it does not reject shared-representation multi-task learning or strict-past auxiliary histories.

## Validation and promotion protocol

Fold B is tuning data because it selects fusion weights. Fold A has been repeatedly exposed to later proposal generation and is no longer a pristine holdout. Before consuming another protected query, the project needs a project-wide hypothesis registry, matched candidate/control seeds, user-cluster uncertainty, slice-level nDCG analysis, and a scoring-equivalence ledger that reuses exact prediction evidence instead of charging a new slot.

## Primary scientific basis

The [KuaiRand paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.08696) and [official repository](https://github.com/chongminggao/KuaiRand) establish the standard-policy versus randomized-intervention boundary and the multi-response schema. The [Counterfactual Watch Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.07932) supports duration-aware watch modeling but does not justify replacing the organizer's authoritative label. [MMoE](https://research.google/pubs/modeling-task-relationships-in-multi-task-learning-with-multi-gate-mixture-of-experts/) and YouTube's [multitask ranking system](https://research.google/pubs/recommending-what-video-to-watch-next-a-multitask-ranking-system/) support auxiliary-task learning when task relationships are measured. [DIN](https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.06978), [DSIN](https://arxiv.org/abs/1905.06482), and [Latent Cross](https://research.google/pubs/latent-cross-making-use-of-context-in-recurrent-recommender-systems/) support behavior- and context-conditioned representations. The [adaptive holdout literature](https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.02629) explains why repeatedly feeding holdout outcomes back into proposal generation invalidates the interpretation of an untouched test set.

These publications motivate controlled hypotheses, not guaranteed gains. The local scorer, legal feature boundary, and matched temporal-fold evidence remain authoritative.

## Definitions, scope, and limitations

The official primary metric is the arithmetic mean of GAUC and nDCG@5. GAUC covers mixed-label users and is weighted by positive count; nDCG@5 covers users equally and only values the top five. No single ordinary loss exactly matches both weightings.

This report used repository code, immutable run artifacts, input-only public/final composition checks, and train-only outcomes. No new paid provider campaign, protected-outcome query, or final-period outcome analysis was run. One exploratory subanalysis accidentally opened a late-log outcome column; every result derived from that access was discarded and excluded from this report, and no model or campaign consumed it. Randomized-log counterfactual training remains blocked until policy propensities, slate semantics, date boundaries, and organizer authorization are established.

The report does not claim that a hidden score will increase. It identifies the experiments with the strongest current evidence and the gates needed to distinguish a real improvement from another plateau.

## Concrete next decision

Run the exact trusted three-member rank portfolio as a first-class, hashed, matched-seed experiment; in parallel, implement only the label-free online exposure state needed for Priority 2. Do not spend another protected query until one frozen candidate clears the predeclared fold, uncertainty, and component gates. If neither experiment improves nDCG@5, move to duration-conditioned pairs and the same-capacity watch-progress multi-task control rather than another broad architecture search.

### Further questions

- Which user/slate/duration strata account for Fold B's nDCG@5 collapse?
- Does the attempt-16 disagreement specialist retain its effect across seeds 1 and 2?
- Does online exposure state help the 3.6% final-input cold-user segment without harming known users?
- Are the randomized-log policy fields sufficient for any defensible counterfactual correction, and is their use allowed?

plateau_diagnosis.evidence: 23 completed current bundles select official-fm-fallback-seed-4 and share the same final-submission and validation-prediction hashes.
plateau_diagnosis.score_consequence: No amount of candidate-side code can change the submitted ranking while final selection returns the fallback.
plateau_diagnosis.response: Evaluate the exact artifact that would be deployed and report challenger-versus-matched-control evidence separately.

plateau_diagnosis.evidence: The supported 0.15/0.30/0.55 pointwise/video-type/control rank blend became pairwise/pointwise/raw-video-type plus a second outer blend.
plateau_diagnosis.score_consequence: Attempt 22 measured a different, scale-sensitive model and lost roughly half of the supported fold gain.
plateau_diagnosis.response: Add trusted three-member within-user rank fusion and replay the frozen weights exactly.

plateau_diagnosis.evidence: Six completed ledger queries have six fingerprints but one candidate, one source, and one three-seed prediction vector.
plateau_diagnosis.score_consequence: New candidates cannot be promoted, while exact replays consumed scarce score slots.
plateau_diagnosis.response: Preserve history; add scoring-equivalence identity and reuse receipts. Obtain reviewed budget authority before any new protected query.

plateau_diagnosis.evidence: Fold B selects fusion weights; Fold A outcomes have been fed into later proposals across many campaign restarts.
plateau_diagnosis.score_consequence: Positive fold deltas increasingly measure selection on known samples rather than generalization.
plateau_diagnosis.response: Use project-wide hypothesis accounting, nested rolling-origin analysis, matched seeds, and user-cluster intervals.

plateau_diagnosis.evidence: Six failed candidate executions were reflected with official-FM sentinel metrics and zero runtime instead of null candidate metrics.
plateau_diagnosis.score_consequence: Potential mechanisms can be blacklisted as scientifically weak even though they never produced predictions.
plateau_diagnosis.response: Separate execution_failed from scientifically_rejected; never attach fallback scores to an unscored candidate.

data_opportunities.measurement: Training long-view rates range from 4.22% on tab 0 to 48.93% on tab 4; tab 1 carries 73.16% of rows at 38.61%.
data_opportunities.implication: Use shared structure with tab-conditioned calibration or small scenario experts; do not fit one undifferentiated residual.

data_opportunities.measurement: Public inputs have earlier same-user context for 82.09% of rows, earlier same-video context for 95.24%, and repeated user-video exposure for 5.67%. Final inputs are at least as rich.
data_opportunities.implication: Add strict-earlier impression counts, first-seen flags, and time-since-last features; update only after equal-time buckets.

data_opportunities.measurement: Unseen-user rows are 1.59% of public inputs and 3.62% of final inputs, while cold videos and authors are negligible.
data_opportunities.implication: Gate to an item/author/context specialist for cold users; train unknown embeddings with controlled field dropout.

data_opportunities.measurement: Clipped watch progress correlates 0.596 with long_view, while 20,889 training rows disagree with the nominal threshold reconstruction.
data_opportunities.implication: Use progress only as a training auxiliary head; keep the supplied long_view label authoritative.

data_opportunities.measurement: Train-only phi with long_view is 0.7605 for click and 0.1461 for profile entry.
data_opportunities.implication: Direct score blending is harmful; test strict-past histories or equal-capacity shared-bottom supervision instead.

data_opportunities.measurement: Tags contain 46 tokens across 111 full strings; 1,791 videos are multi-tag. Aspect, upload age, and music fields remain mostly disabled.
data_opportunities.implication: Use tokenized tag affinities and simple geometry/age interactions only after the higher-priority temporal and objective tests.

experiment_program.treatment: Treatment: 0.15 pointwise + 0.30 video-type + 0.55 official-FM, each converted to within-user midranks. Control: exact official FM and existing two-member fusion, with no weight retuning. Expected: about +0.002 on both folds with complementary user wins. Falsify if a fold loses the diagnostic value, seed variation dominates, or top-five overlap shows no complementarity.
experiment_program.control: Exact official FM and the existing two-member fusion; no weight retuning.
experiment_program.expected_signature: Reproduce approximately +0.002 primary on both folds with complementary per-user wins.
experiment_program.falsifier: Any fold loses the diagnostic value, seed variation dominates, or top-five overlap shows no complementarity.

experiment_program.treatment: Treatment: strict-earlier user/video/user-video counts, time-since-last, first-seen flags, public-input warm-up for final, and a cold-user gate. Control: frozen-prefix v7 features with identical model and compute. Expected: nDCG gain in repeat and cold-user slices. Falsify if shuffled-safe exposure features match treatment or gains vanish under same-timestamp isolation.
experiment_program.control: Frozen-prefix v7 features with identical model and compute.
experiment_program.expected_signature: nDCG gain in repeated-exposure and cold-user slices without regression for established users.
experiment_program.falsifier: Shuffle-safe exposure features add no slice gain or improvements vanish under same-timestamp isolation.

experiment_program.treatment: Treatment: fixed mixture of uniform observed same-user pairs and same-duration-bucket pairs at equal total budget. Control: exact protected positive-ticket, uniform-negative GAUC sampler. Expected: better top-five swaps within duration regimes. Falsify if shuffled duration buckets perform the same or gains do not localize to duration slices.
experiment_program.control: Exact protected positive-ticket, uniform-negative GAUC sampler.
experiment_program.expected_signature: Better top-five swaps within duration regimes and primary gain without broad GAUC loss.
experiment_program.falsifier: Shuffled duration buckets perform the same or gains do not appear in duration slices.

experiment_program.treatment: Treatment: shared bottom with authoritative long_view and clipped-progress heads; add click only after the two-head result. Control: equal-capacity long_view-only network, auxiliary weight zero, and shuffled progress. Expected: more stable threshold-near and sparse-history ordering. Falsify if only auxiliary loss moves or shuffled progress matches treatment.
experiment_program.control: Equal-capacity long_view-only network, auxiliary weight zero, and shuffled progress.
experiment_program.expected_signature: More stable ordering near the long-view boundary and in sparse-history users.
experiment_program.falsifier: Auxiliary loss improves while organizer primary does not, or shuffled progress matches treatment.

experiment_program.treatment: Treatment: corrected LambdaLoss@5 or 50/50 uniform and previous-epoch observed hard negatives, with fixed representation and budget. Control: current positive-only list loss and exact uniform-negative sampler. Expected: nDCG@5 moves more than GAUC at ranks one through five. Falsify if top-five swaps do not improve or stale-score mining dominates.
experiment_program.control: Current positive-only list loss and exact uniform-negative pairwise sampler.
experiment_program.expected_signature: nDCG@5 improves more than GAUC, concentrated at ranks one through five.
experiment_program.falsifier: No top-five swap improvement, stale-score mining dominates, or only a library metric moves.

experiment_program.experiment: Scenario experts and structured tag affinity
experiment_program.treatment: Treatment: small tab-conditioned experts plus tokenized user-tag strict-past affinity and support-aware smoothing. Control: equal-capacity shared model with raw tab and existing aggregates. Expected: gains in low-support tabs and cold users without losing tab 1. Falsify if routing merely reproduces prevalence or token shuffling preserves the gain.
experiment_program.control: Same total-capacity shared model with raw tab and existing aggregate scopes.
experiment_program.expected_signature: Gains in low-support tabs and cold-user rows without losing dominant tab 1.
experiment_program.falsifier: Expert routing collapses to tab prevalence or token shuffling preserves the gain.

experiment_program.treatment: Treatment only after authorization: support audit and representation regularization, with standard-policy evaluation authoritative. Control: standard-policy-only training. Expected: robustness only in supported user-item regions. Block or falsify if policy semantics, support, dates, or organizer permission cannot be established.
experiment_program.expected_signature: Improved robustness in supported user-item regions without relying on unavailable propensities.
experiment_program.falsifier: Policy semantics, action support, date boundaries, or organizer permission cannot be established.

falsified_shortcuts.result: All tested Fold B weights from 0.05 to 0.20 were worse than the base portfolio; the selector chose weight 0.
falsified_shortcuts.decision: Do not blend a standalone click rank score. Retain click only for strict-past histories or controlled multi-task supervision.

falsified_shortcuts.result: All tested Fold B weights from 0.05 to 0.20 reduced primary; the selector chose weight 0.
falsified_shortcuts.decision: Do not use profile entry as a direct ranking score.

falsified_shortcuts.result: Produced +0.000688 on Fold A and +0.001531 on Fold B versus +0.001988/+0.002006 for the faithful rank portfolio.
falsified_shortcuts.decision: Treat Attempt 22 as a wiring failure, not evidence against the intended portfolio.

falsified_shortcuts.result: Mean primary delta was +0.00004225; one of three seeds was negative and the user-cluster interval crossed zero.
falsified_shortcuts.decision: Treat as noise, not performance evidence.

falsified_shortcuts.idea: More broad residual capacity on the same matrix
falsified_shortcuts.result: Listwise, deep-cross, graph, attention, manifold, and temporal residual candidates repeatedly plateau around sub-0.002 fold gains.
falsified_shortcuts.decision: Require a distinct information source or metric mechanism before adding architecture.

falsified_shortcuts.idea: Naive IPS or full-catalog negative correction
falsified_shortcuts.result: The local impression log has no displayed-slate ranks or action propensities, and the randomized-log policy semantics are unresolved.
falsified_shortcuts.decision: Do not claim unbiased counterfactual learning without the missing support and policy information.

promotion_protocol.requirement: Hash source, feature schema, data window, seed, model, fusion recipe, and exact prediction vector; evaluate the artifact that would be submitted.
promotion_protocol.reason: Prevents a diagnostic recipe or fallback from being reported as a challenger.

promotion_protocol.requirement: At minimum seeds 0, 1, and 2 for both candidate and control; report per-seed deltas, mean, dispersion, and rank-averaged ensemble.
promotion_protocol.reason: The FM seed range is about 0.000947, much larger than the prior matched-seed gain.

promotion_protocol.requirement: Freeze every choice before Fold A, add rolling-origin day slices, and stop feeding confirmation results into proposal generation.
promotion_protocol.reason: Fold B is selected on and Fold A has been adaptively reused.

promotion_protocol.requirement: Bootstrap complete users and report GAUC, nDCG@5, primary, and a confidence interval for paired deltas.
promotion_protocol.reason: Rows within a user are not independent; the prior interval crossed zero.

promotion_protocol.requirement: Predeclare the +0.002 per-fold primary rule, component-regression tolerance, and slices for tab, duration, history, slate size, positives, and cold start.
promotion_protocol.reason: The present bottleneck is top-five behavior and could be hidden by aggregate GAUC.

promotion_protocol.requirement: Deduplicate exact within-user ordering or aligned prediction digests and reuse prior receipts; never rewrite the append-only history.
promotion_protocol.reason: Six nominal outer slots currently represent one prediction hypothesis.

promotion_protocol.requirement: Execution failures carry null metrics and cannot advance non-material convergence or mechanism blacklists.
promotion_protocol.reason: A model that never scored has not been scientifically rejected.
